facts.event: Elise 在贵族营地撞见被放逐十年的 Alar 归来，用掌心的梭子刺自己压住尖叫，仍留在 Tilde 身边
facts.relation: Elise 与异母兄 Alar（羞耻与恐惧）
facts.anchor: she took her desire to scream, and punctured it with her sharp shuttle in her palm

facts.event: Elise 低声向 Tilde 解释汗帐是 Cynghal 传统，用于洗浴或战事会议，猜父亲是要听她们谏言
facts.relation: Elise 与王后 Tilde（依赖/安抚）
facts.anchor: ‘It’s a sweating tent,’ said Elise. Her throat was dry.

facts.event: Tilde 说银王后有自己的‘妻子们’，Elise 斥其不合翼之法，两人之间生出暧昧张力
facts.relation: Tilde 与 Elise（信仰冲突/情欲）
facts.anchor: ‘Wives,’ echoed Elise. ‘I thought the silver queen was a woman.’

facts.event: Elise 意识到 Alar 已被逐出 Merogia 十年，穿南岸风暴赶回绝非只为迎一位王后
facts.relation: Alar 与 Merogia 王室（流亡者归来）
facts.anchor: he had been banished from Merogia for a decade

facts.event: Liran 把 Hein 那桶冷水泼向揪打的 Alar 与 Conrin，骂他们一半是刚破壳的雏鸟
facts.anchor: Liran picked up Hein’s bucket of water and threw the cold liquid over the two of them

facts.event: Alar 警告 Liran：拷打只能榨出她已说的或他想听的话，还会让他少一位王后
facts.anchor: Torture will extract either what she has told you, or what she thinks you want to know

facts.event: Liran 采纳 Merovin 的提议，命他护送 Tilde 去营地，定黎明试行和谈
facts.relation: Liran 与 Tilde、Ducal Merovin（把王后当筹码）
facts.anchor: At dawn, we will try this parley, and see if a woman can do what all you men of my blood cannot.

facts.event: Conrin 告知 Ducal Kerrin 已死且被‘swan’，其妻 Lady Henoveva 仍守内墙，Elise 判断内墙粮足只可撑数周
facts.anchor: ‘And swanned,’ said Conrin. ‘Looks like Isen is losing his touch.’
